title: Ottomans destroy the Mamluk army at Marj Dabiq
summary: Selim I defeated the Mamluk Sultan Qansuh al-Ghawri north of Aleppo. The sultan died on the field and Syria passed to the Ottomans.
reason: Rivalry over the frontier and fears of a Mamluk alliance with Safavid Persia drove Selim to attack.
significance: It opened the way to the Ottoman conquest of Egypt and made the Ottomans guardians of Mecca and Medina.
